items.name: wt.session
items.purpose: Anonymous session id (UUIDv4), session start, last activity and a sampling draw
items.lifetime: Cleared when the tab closes; rolls over after 30 minutes idle or 4 hours total; removed by revokeConsent()

items.name: wt.anon
items.lifetime: Until cleared; only written when persistAnonId is true; removed by revokeConsent()

items.name: wt-offline
items.purpose: Event batches that could not be sent (offline or 5xx), resent later; bounded count
items.lifetime: Until the batch is delivered or the bounded store overflows; emptied by revokeConsent()
items.writtenWhen: consent, and only while the network refuses a send

items.name: wt-offline-logs
items.purpose: Log batches that could not be sent, resent later; bounded count
items.lifetime: Until the batch is delivered or the bounded store overflows; emptied by revokeConsent()
items.writtenWhen: consent, and only while the network refuses a send
